incidents.name: LavaLending
incidents.notes: LP vault deposit/compound/withdraw accounting inflated collateral value to over-borrow the lending pool

sources.ref: re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The victim is an ERC-1967 beacon proxy: the beacon slot 0xa3f0ad74e5423aebfd80d3ef4346578335a9a72aeaee59ff6cb3582b35133d50 holds 0x090287f882669268aea53be5b3fb284facf7bae6 at all 21 sample points across [213419780, 259645908], and that beacon's implementation (its storage slot 1) holds 0x1e515301f24abbf92dfb3d071e062739a8827b4d over the same probe, with its single Upgraded event at block 213419690 - 90 blocks (23 s) before the proxy itself was created. callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the proxy delegatecalls only 0x1e515301... .

incidents.name: LavaLending UniV3Wrapper unclaimed-fee inflation
incidents.notes: UniV3Wrapper.getUnclaimedFees() ran its _limitFees() cap only against combined two-token fee growth, so fees generated in a single token by attacker-driven swaps in the USDC/USDC.e pool were added in full to getAssetsBasedOnPrice(), inflating the wrapper LP price read by the lending market's WrapperOracle and allowing an over-borrow.

sources.ref: onchain review: UniV3Wrapper ERC1967 proxy 0x10bda01ac4e644fd84a04dab01e15a5edcee46dd created 2024-02-19 by Lava deployer 0xe56a6ca72979a511782cf6d4d0e3be80b6f1e681, last Upgraded event 2024-03-07 to impl 0xf6b3c18023c1e387a673b3101c73fc985290fbd9 whose getUnclaimedFees()/_limitFees() is the code the team announced it would fix; attack sender 0x851aa754c39bf23cdaac2025367514dfd7530418 is unrelated to the creator
